Hello coz夏さん! First of all, it is very interesting you are using the Mandarin pronunciation of "夏".  I'm Taiwanese American!
Thank you very much for the appeal.
"Chill vibe", "egg", "bubble tea", and "everyday scene"... you have found some magic words that are things that make me really happy!
I'm very happy you took a liking to the subjects I love to commission.
I think your ideas are amazing! Personally for me, after looking through your wonderful art, I would love to see what kind of "everyday scene" you would imagine her in. 
I see you also like yuri and futa. If you would like to be brave, I also love yuri AND futa.
I leave it up to you if you'd like to explore those themes, I give you full permission!  Maybe with a character of yours? (lol)

With that being said, please have fun with it. I can't wait to see what you have in mind. Thank you so much! 💚

https://imgur.com/a/8rprgI3

I would love to have an artpiece from you, I have references in the form of 3D model photos, I have a reference sheet being worked on so I apologize!

Here is the link to the references, please do check them and decide if you'll take the request or not!
(Please do note the references are NSFW to show the full body as I do not have a SFW alternative just yet, it also includes the outfit/lingerie set of choice)

I'd be very happy if you accept, I will also be sure to have a proper Reference Sheet (with a SFW alt) for any future commissions!

Hello Coz. Was looking around skeb for a nice furry artist and found you. I love your style and am trying to get a little present for someone.

I don't want to be too restrictive with my request so to keep it simple; I want it with a Christmas or New Years theme whichever one you think sounds more fun for you. And the pair are a couple so I'd like some way for that to be shown. Hugging, nuzzling, licking, kissing, whatever works best for you. I'll be sending references for both characters so you have a full character to look at and worth with for each.

And the details don't quite come out right but if they're full body in the art, the characters are both foxes so the tails of each should be a little fluffier than they appear in the references, kind of like a red fox's would be.

Hope winter is treating you well and you're staying warm!

Reference: https://imgur.com/a/hnIKnPo

https://imgur.com/a/ofxOrqi

2. I want my ooc to be wearing a sweater and have his chest on a fox (I will give you a reference picture of what the fox looks like).

前回のリクエスト、ありがとうございました！

私のオリジナルキャラクターを描いていただけませんか？

名前はアロイス。侵略してくるエイリアンと戦う秘密組織の一員です。
とてもおしゃべりで、いたずら好きで、おちゃめな性格。
ロック音楽、お菓子作り、スケッチが好き。
スナイパーでもある。
普段の表情はいたずらっぽい大きな笑み。
体型は痩せ型。

ポーズのアイデアは以下の通り：
- クッキーを焼く
- エイリアンのモンスターと戦う
- エレキギターを弾くふりをする
- クールでエッジの効いたアクションポーズ
- その他お好きなポーズ

ポーズや構図はお任せします！

良ければうちの子の竜人を手掛けて頂けませんか？

また、お願いしたい差分の内容なのですが、彼女のお腹が大きく膨らんでいる姿をお願い出来ませんか？
大きければ大きいほど嬉しいですが、coz夏様の気分の乗る範囲で膨らまして頂けますと嬉しいです！

ぜひご検討をお願い申し上げます。
